title: AG60051: Open Channel Hydraulics And Coastal Engg.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Open Channel and their Properties, Energy and Momentum Principle, Critical
Flow, Uniform Flow, Design of Channels for Uniform flow, Gradually Varied Flow,
Flow Profile Analysis, Flow Over Spillway, Hydraulic Jump, Flow Through Nonprismatic Channel, Gradually Varied unsteady Flow. Equilibrium and Dynamic
Theory of Tides, Types of Tides and Tidal Theory, Tidal Propagation in the
Channel, Estuaries and Coastal Inlets, Tidal Mixing.Properties of Ocean Water,
Provinces of Ocean,Generation and Prediction of waves, Propagation and
Transformation of Waves, Longshore Currents, Rip Current, Littoral Transport,
Artificial Protection of Coastline- Structure and forces acting on them,
Coastal Protection Planning for Design of Aquacultural Farm.
